verdict.rationale: The evidence covers pay-per-use billing, per-model cost estimates, scale-to-zero and performance metrics. None of it documents spending caps, hard limits or budget alerts that would stop or flag a runaway workload. These are adjacent billing behaviors, not the capability itself, so the applicable axis earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
